description: This Java class 'ContactAccessorSdk3_4' extends 'ContactAccessor' to provide legacy contact access functionality using deprecated Android Contacts APIs, specifically for pre-Eclair SDK versions. It includes methods to create a contact picker intent and load contact details (name and phone number) from contact URIs.

classes.name: ContactAccessorSdk3_4
classes.description: Implementation of contact data retrieval using legacy Android Contacts API for pre-Eclair devices. Includes methods to generate contact pick intent and load contact info (name and phone number).

methods.name: getPickContactIntent
methods.description: Returns an Intent to pick a contact, using the legacy Content URI for contacts.

methods.name: loadContact
methods.description: Loads contact display name and primary phone number from provided contact URI, returning a ContactInfo object with the retrieved data.
